CALIBRATION CERTIFICATE
Ref. No.: NLW.4851.<% zlecenie.ID_zlecenia %>.<% zlecenie.Data_przyjecia.rok %>.W
Date of issue: <% tekst(data_wydania) %> Certificate No.: <% nr_swiadectwa %> Page /
This certificate may not be copied otherwise than as a whole document without the consent of the Laboratory.
CALIBRATION CERTIFICATE issued by ACCREDITED LABORATORY No. AP 029
Date of issue: <% tekst(data_wydania) %> Certificate No.: <% nr_swiadectwa %> Page /
OBJECT OF CALIBRATION Name <% tr(przyrzad.Nazwa) %>
Type <% trOpt(przyrzad.Typ) %>
Serial number <% trOpt(przyrzad.Nr_fabryczny) %>
Manufacturer <% trOpt(przyrzad.Producent) %>
Year of production <% tr(przyrzad.Rok_produkcji) %>
APPLICANT <%= multiline(zleceniodawca.Zleceniodawca, ';') %>
<%= multiline(zleceniodawca.Adres, ';') %>
CALIBRATION METHOD <% metody[metoda] %>
LOCATION OF LABORATORY ACTIVITY At the laboratory permanent facility
ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS Pressure (<% tekst(warunkiMin.cisnienie - stale.UNCERTAINITY_PRESSURE_VALUE) %> - <% tekst(warunkiMax.cisnienie + stale.UNCERTAINITY_PRESSURE_VALUE) %>) hPa
Temperature (<% tekst(warunkiMin.temperatura - stale.UNCERTAINITY_TEMPERATURE_VALUE) %> - <% tekst(warunkiMax.temperatura + stale.UNCERTAINITY_TEMPERATURE_VALUE) %>) oC
Humidity (<% tekst(warunkiMin.wilgotnosc - stale.UNCERTAINITY_HUMIDITY_VALUE) %> - <% tekst(warunkiMax.wilgotnosc + stale.UNCERTAINITY_HUMIDITY_VALUE) %>) %
DATE OF RECEIPT <% tekst(zlecenie.Data_przyjecia) %>
DATE OF CALIBRATION <% tekst(data_wykonania) %>
TRACEABILITY <% spojnosciPomiarowe[spojnoscPomiarowa] %>
CALIBRATION RESULTS
The results have been presented on page 2 of this certificate including uncertainty of measurement. These results relate only to the objects subjected to calibration.
UNCERTAINTY OF MEASUREMENT
Uncertainty of measurement has been evaluated in compliance with EA‑4/02 M:2022. The expanded uncertainty assigned corresponds to a coverage probability of 95% and coverage factor k = 2.
CALIBRATION RESULTS Calibration results are presented below:
